So, instead of taking money from the treasure chest (not taking a salary), the captain might use some of the ship’s money to make changes to their own house (remodeling their home) or to pay for a fancy car to drive (leasing a Mercedes). They might do this by using the money the ship makes, or maybe they convince the ship’s helpers (investors) to give them special permission to use some of the ship’s money for these things, even if it’s not called a “salary.”

So, even if the captain says, “I’m not taking a salary,” they might still be using the ship’s money for themselves in other ways.
